DTO.name: SubmarineGyroDTO
DTO.MATH: Six 4-byte fields = 24 bytes; two explicit uint pads = 8 bytes; total = 32 bytes. 32 mod 8 = 0 and 32 mod 16 = 0.

STRUCT_LAYOUT_VERIFICATION.DTO: AUP double3 starts at 0, float3 lanes are 4-byte aligned, tail padding fills one cache line.
Two-cache-line forensic packet. `double3 CurrentAup@0`; float3 torque/accel/error/omega lanes begin on 4-byte offsets; tail padding reaches 128.
Blackbox row is one cache line; scalar reductions and flags occupy offsets 0..44, explicit ulong pads at 48 and 56.
GPU-facing row contains only float/uint lanes: `ErrorVector@0`, `Effort01@12`, horizon angles `16/20`, `CorrectiveTorque@24`, IDs/flags `36..44`, pads `48/56`.
Reduction row is padded to a full 64-byte line; no adjacent hot counter sharing.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE_EXPLANATION: `GlobalQualityWeight` is clamped to 0..1 and passed into `EvaluatePdControllerJob`. Below roughly 0.3, tensor work collapses toward diagonal angular inertia through `ResolveTensorBlend`, preserving stabilization truth while avoiding full matrix multiply cost. Middle weights blend diagonal and full inverse tensor response without feature pop. High and Ultra weights use the full added-mass angular response and preserve richer visual-state data for cockpit shaders. Quality scales cost and presentation only; BufferIDs, DTO layout, rollback identity, and torque ownership remain fixed.
